verdict.rationale: A probe confirms https://www.dropbox.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with actual content, and dropbox-docs-15 cites it, showing Dropbox does publish an llms.txt file an agent could be pointed at. However, the content appears to be brief marketing copy rather than deep agent-oriented API documentation, and attempts to find companion machine-readable docs (docs.md, OpenAPI spec) all 404'd. Missing for 10: richer llms.txt content covering API/developer docs, a markdown mirror of developer docs, and an OpenAPI/machine-readable spec for agents to consume.
